zones.title: 1. Notify, then pull
zones.body: A Pub/Sub push lands here and is acknowledged at once; it carries only a pointer. The email and its attachments are pulled from the mailbox afterwards (Gmail API in production) and the order record is opened. Pub/Sub delivers at least once: a notification for an order that already exists is logged and dropped. The order id is set as execution custom data, so Executions can be filtered by order.

zones.title: 2. Read the attachment
zones.body: The first attachment is routed by type: PDF text, XLSX or CSV rows (flattened to text), or none. Everything is joined with the email body into one document. DOCX and scans go to Document AI on the customer instance.

zones.title: 3. Zero-shot extraction
zones.body: The Information Extractor reads the document against a fixed schema: intent, customer, Ship-To as written, product lines, empty cylinder returns, reasoning and confidence. No templates, no training. Prompt and completion tokens of every model call are written to step_log. Non-orders stop after the log.

zones.title: 4. Specialist agents
zones.body: Two sub-workflow agents validate against Salesforce (lab: Postgres). The Product Agent resolves every line to exactly one catalogue code; the Shipping Agent resolves Sold-To, Ship-To and the plant cut-off. Each agent's tool calls are logged as reflection steps.

zones.title: 5. Deterministic gate
zones.body: Code, not a model, decides. Critical rules (intent, account, every product code, Ship-To, quantities) must all pass. Review rules: Elephant Order, empty cylinder returns, confidence threshold. Thresholds come from n8n Variables (AL_PG_*), editable in Settings without a redeploy. Every time the deterministic layer overruled an agent, a guard event is logged.

zones.title: 6. Order desk (HITL)
zones.body: Auto goes straight to posting. Anything else becomes a pre-filled Draft Order with an AI-written note (fixed reason wording from the gate) and the order desk gets Approve / Reject links. The execution sleeps on the Wait node until they click.

zones.title: 7. Post to SAP through the ESB
zones.body: One sales-order call to the TIBCO endpoint (lab: mock). On a 5xx the loop waits 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 s between attempts, five retries over about two minutes, each one logged. After the fifth failure the validated order is escalated to the order desk and marked failed.

zones.title: 8. Failures
zones.body: Every fallible node routes its error output here. Ops gets the error, the order id and the execution id. Nothing is posted on a failure.

panels.title: PG Order Intake, PoC
panels.body:
Air Liquide RFP PoC, order-to-cash intake. Email in, SAP sales order or Salesforce Draft Order out, under five minutes.

Lab stand-ins: Postgres al_poc plays Gmail (mailbox), Salesforce (accounts, partner_roles, product_catalog, draft_orders), the OCB cut-off API (cut_offs) and SAP (sales_orders). The mock TIBCO workflow is the ESB. LM Studio plays Gemini. Mailpit is the order desk inbox. Dashboard: /webhook/al-pg-order-metrics. Settings > Variables: AL_PG_AUTO_CONFIDENCE_MIN, AL_PG_ELEPHANT_QTY, AL_PG_ESB_MAX_ATTEMPTS, AL_PG_ESB_BACKOFF_BASE_S.

Test: python3 scripts/send-fixture.py data/fixtures/<fixture>.json [--chaos N]
